candidates.formal_type:
∀ (p : Nat) [hp : Fact (Nat.Prime p)] (n : Nat)
  (mu nu : MonoidHom.{0, 0} (Units.{0} (GaloisField p n)) (Units.{0} Complex)),
  Iff (Nonempty.{1} (CategoryTheory.Iso.{0, 1} (Etingof.GL2.complementW p n mu) (Etingof.GL2.complementW p n nu)))
    (Eq.{1} mu nu)

∀ (p : Nat) [hp : Fact (Nat.Prime p)] (n : Nat) [NeZero.{0} n]
  (chi1 chi2 chi1' chi2' : MonoidHom.{0, 0} (Units.{0} (GaloisField p n)) (Units.{0} Complex)),
  Ne.{1} chi1 chi2 →
    Ne.{1} chi1' chi2' →
      Iff
        (Nonempty.{1}
          (CategoryTheory.Iso.{0, 1} (Etingof.GL2.principalSeries p n chi1 chi2)
            (Etingof.GL2.principalSeries p n chi1' chi2')))
        (Eq.{1} (Insert.insert.{0, 0} chi1 (Singleton.singleton.{0, 0} chi2))
          (Insert.insert.{0, 0} chi1' (Singleton.singleton.{0, 0} chi2')))
